songs.title: Heartbeat
songs.subtitle: the specimen stirs
songs.story: The specimen's heart is already ticking. Its brain is waiting for a reason to join in.
songs.fact: A connectome is a map of neural connections. In this demo, the wiring is synthetic and generated locally.

songs.title: Morning Scent
songs.subtitle: follow the fragrance
songs.story: A new scent rolls across the antennae. Left side, right side. Can you keep the conversation going?
songs.fact: Olfactory input is represented here by separate left and right synthetic seed groups.

songs.title: Shadow Overhead
songs.subtitle: something passes above
songs.story: Light dims. A shadow sweeps overhead. Your timing is the specimen's only warning.
songs.fact: The looming-signal pattern is an envelope applied to the demo visual seed group.

songs.title: Sweet Tooth
songs.subtitle: a taste for rhythm
songs.story: A sugar trace hits the taste sensors. It swells, fades, and comes back sweeter.
songs.fact: Taste input is a named synthetic stimulus group in this teaching network.

songs.title: Ping-Pong
songs.subtitle: left brain / right brain
songs.story: Left. Right. Left. Right. The two hemispheres are trading a signal at full speed.
songs.fact: The side labels are part of the generated demo layout, not real anatomical measurements.

songs.title: Storm
songs.subtitle: everything at once
songs.story: The lab lights flicker. Four sensory streams converge. Keep the fly's signal alive.
songs.fact: Multiple input shapes can overlap. Neural activity still comes from the same deterministic simulation.
